trigger: a deployment with a stored heartbeat_timeout of 1 to 29 restarts on the new build
classification_rationale: a required item or test is missing
summary: A heartbeat_timeout stored below 30 (accepted by the earlier route and page) was applied at boot with no doc or changelog saying otherwise; the new floor then silently differed from the stored value. I7 raised to HIGH: the omission conceals a migration step. Also reported by: docs-writer + enterprise-readiness + sre + architect + happy-path + consistency-auditor. Resolution: Boot loader raises a sub-floor value to the floor through clamp_heartbeat_timeout with a WARN naming the remedy; documented in the fragment, upgrading.md, rest-api.md, server-admin.md; helper unit-tested and the call pinned by a source tripwire (964680228, 39b26d589, 33aaefc04).

trigger: an existing cookie-based script or SIEM rule meets the upgraded server
classification_rationale: a required item or test is missing
summary: The fragment was a plain security bullet with no Breaking marker and upgrading.md had no entry, though a cookie PUT without Origin now fails 403, heartbeat_timeout below 30 now fails 400, each change leaves two audit rows and a PUT can 503 during an audit outage. Derived HIGH (concealed breaking change). Resolution: Breaking lead on the fragment and a new upgrading.md entry covering all four changes, the proxy remedy and the stored-value case (39b26d589, 33aaefc04).

trigger: the connection drops after Postgres commits but before the acknowledgement reaches the server
classification_rationale: the text or test contradicts what the code does or claims
summary: The failure audit row said 'not applied' for every refusal, including a database error whose commit may have succeeded before the acknowledgement was lost, so the row could state the opposite of what is stored. Derived HIGH (wrong result presented as correct). Also reported by: compliance-officer + consistency-auditor. Resolution: A database error records 'store error; outcome unknown'; a refusal records the store's operator-written text, never the value; documented, with the lone-attempted-row meaning (964680228, 33aaefc04). The database-error branch has no unit test (no store fault seam); the refusal branch and the placeholder-secret case are tested.
